title: SMTP Service Extension for Message Size Declaration
summary: Defines an SMTP extension that lets a client declare the size of a message in advance so the server can decline it, perhaps temporarily, before the whole thing is sent. It is an Internet Standard.

eli5.summary: Tell the post office how big the package is before dropping it off, so they can refuse it without you carrying it in.

questions: what is the smtp size extension
how does smtp reject large messages early
